script_text: Stop, Pisces—the stars are flashing red around your money and messages. The Sun is separating from a conjunction with Uranus in your 4th House of home, while Mercury in your 5th House trines Saturn in your 2nd House of income and squares Pluto in your 12th House. Mars in Taurus is also squaring Pluto, activating your 3rd House of texts, calls, errands, and short trips. Your Neptune-ruled Water nature may feel the pressure first. If single, you attract an intense, artistic person through home, family, or a late-night chat; if taken, one honest confession deepens intimacy, but avoid testing loyalty. With Mercury trining Saturn in your 2nd House, ask for the rate, approve the invoice, or revise a creative offer; terms must be clear. Avoid signing in panic, because Mars square Pluto can turn a text into a power struggle. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
